name: CAFA5 Critical Assessment of Functional Annotation
description: A community challenge benchmark for protein function annotation, centered on predicting Gene Ontology-style functional labels from biological sequence and related evidence.
evaluation_method: typically evaluated with precision/recall-style metrics for functional annotation, often including Fmax and area under the precision-recall curve across ontology terms
notes: CAFA is a well-known recurring benchmark for automated protein function prediction. The exact setup can vary by round, so the number of questions is not fixed here.

scientists: Protein Function Annotation community challenge organizers
institutions: Critical Assessment of Functional Annotation (CAFA) organizers
